Hero.Title: Tax and administration
Hero.Description: Coordination of your Swiss tax compliance and day-to-day administration. We oversee filings, payments, cash flow and document management for family members and their structures.

Intro: A family and its holding structures generate a constant flow of tax and administrative obligations. Taken individually they are manageable; together they call for rigorous coordination.
We coordinate this compliance and administration, drawing on the expertise of an established Geneva fiduciary group. You keep the overview, without carrying the load.

Pillars.Title: Swiss tax compliance
Pillars.Body: Coordination of filings and tax obligations for family members and holding structures.

Pillars.Title: Administrative oversight
Pillars.Body: Tracking of deadlines, formalities and counterparties, for administration with no blind spots.

Pillars.Title: Payments and cash flow
Pillars.Body: Administration of payments and monitoring of cash flow, with controls and traceability.

Pillars.Title: Document management
Pillars.Body: Filing, retention and provision of the documents your advisors need.

Pillars.Title: Tax optimisation
Pillars.Body: Tax planning and optimisation within the Swiss framework: structuring of income and holdings, lump-sum taxation (forfait fiscal) for families relocating to Switzerland, and coordination of the arrival with cantonal authorities.

Pillars.Title: Domiciliation and mail
Pillars.Body: Domiciliation of structures in Geneva, receipt and management of the family's and entities' mail: sorting, digitisation, forwarding and follow-up of required actions.

Pillars.Title: Payroll management
Pillars.Body: Payroll for all your employer roles: household staff, employees of your structures and of your family office — contracts, Swissdec payroll, social insurance, source tax and permits.

Closing.Title: Administration under control
Closing.Body: You keep control and the overview; we take on the administrative execution and the coordination with your tax advisors.

Perimeter: Tax and administrative coordination is carried out with your tax and legal advisors. Ridger provides coordination, reporting and administrative oversight. Ridger does not manage assets and does not provide investment advice.
